outcome: respectful maternity care (measured by a 15-item tool with four domains: friendly, abuse-free, timely, and discrimination-free care)
cohort: Postnatal women delivering in a tertiary care public hospital (n=264) and a tertiary care private hospital (n=334) in Chittagong, Bangladesh.
finding: Overall, 55.5% of postnatal women received respectful maternity care, with significantly higher rates in private hospitals (72.8%) compared to public hospitals (33.7%), and it was positively associated with private hospital delivery, facility-level referrals, and cesarean deliveries.
mod_finding: Women undergoing cesarean deliveries were significantly more likely to receive respectful maternity care (aOR 2.45; 95% CI 1.26-5.07).
